authorizationScope: Only HOU and DAL data may be used for the next training increment. Full-league source responses are provenance history, not active training data.
teamMembershipSemantics: Team assignments reflect the logo/TEAMID labels in the current public season snapshots, not event-date membership or verified historical rosters.

filter.gravityAndLeverage: data.players rows where all parsable lightLogo/darkLogo basenames agree exactly on HOU_logo.png or DAL_logo.png; map HOU→1610612745 and DAL→1610612742
filter.sort: Rows and players sorted by snapshotTeamAbbreviation, then string playerId
filter.keepMissing: Missing metric families remain absent and are listed in missingMetricFamilies; never fill with zero.

shotDatasetCrossCheck.note: Two-team season context covers more players than the shotDifficulty-profile-based harvested shot set; this does not add per-shot labels for those extra players.
